fusions.name: Threaded Glance
fusions.desc: A weighted cord threaded through a gap in the target's guard that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles, and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds, with a 45% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Seeker's Mesh
fusions.desc: Throws a mesh around you in which every knot finds a weak spot, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit and leaves its target [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Watching Knot
fusions.desc: Sets down a knot of mesh with a lidless gaze for 12 seconds. It strikes an enemy within 3 tiles for 3 damage every second, each strike with a 35% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Sharper Each Blink
fusions.desc: Every time you land a critical hit, a watching knot opens on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per knot (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a knot fades every 6 seconds.
